run_tool_1A_pipeline: run the full tool 1A Mechanical Turk annotation pipeline end to end with --default_write_dir
create_turk_job: create Mechanical Turk HITs from a CSV input file using an XML template via create_turk_job
get_hits_result: fetch completed Mechanical Turk assignment results in batches and save them to a CSV file
collate_turk_outputs: collate Mechanical Turk output data with input job specs using collate_answers.py
generate_inputs_for_tools_B_and_C: generate input files for downstream tools B and C from processed tool A outputs
